info.name: Azure Event Hubs Management REST API
info.description:
Azure Resource Manager REST API for managing Event Hubs namespaces, event hubs, consumer groups, authorization rules, disaster recovery configurations, and schema registry groups. This API uses the Microsoft.EventHub resource provider and operates on the Azure management plane at management.azure.com.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Azure Support
